# Opal Pettigrew

[Regent’s Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Opal Pettigrew is considered the most beautiful girl at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), possessing a truly striking appearance. She features big, vivid blue eyes, radiant skin with a healthy complexion, and a full, eye-catching, vigorous figure. Her long blonde hair is worn in a lengthy plait.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Opal Pettigrew possesses a sunny and pleasant disposition, openly delighting in life, though she can also be sentimental and prone to hysteria. Her thoughts are heavily preoccupied with romance; she intends to get a boyfriend at age fifteen, keep numerous suitors dangling once she is an adult, and teach for only two years after qualifying before marrying. Additionally, she harbors a intense terror of plump green caterpillars and fears lying flat to feign death on a floating craft.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), +3 more_

## Goals

## History

Opal Pettigrew grew up as one of many daughters who were rapidly married off. In her youth, she cured all of her warts by using an enchanted stone obtained from old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) from the Creek. She also hid inside a hallway pantry to eavesdrop when her sister [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) received a marriage proposal from Malcolm Andres.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017)_
